subject.title: Expose maxMissedJobsPerRestart and missedJobStaggerMs in cron config

question: Should OpenClaw expose public cron restart catch-up controls, and which shape should become the supported config contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the choice changes restart semantics for existing scheduled jobs and adds compatibility-sensitive public config.

options.title: Expose narrow global controls
options.body: Approve documented global cron restart catch-up controls using the existing internal max/stagger behavior, including explicit zero-limit disable semantics.

options.title: Design a catch-up policy
options.body: Choose a global or per-job skip/catch-up policy first, preserving current catch-up defaults until the supported policy is implemented.

options.title: Keep controls internal
options.body: Decline new public config and document the fixed restart catch-up behavior and operational workarounds.

recommendation.title: Expose narrow global controls
recommendation.body: Approve documented global cron restart catch-up controls using the existing internal max/stagger behavior, including explicit zero-limit disable semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete committed the original internal stagger change and the decision is primarily public config and scheduler semantics.
